decision_conditions: The proposed two storey side extension, by virtue of its detailed design, form, siting, bulk and materials proximity would appear visually intrusive, incongruous, overly dominant and out of keeping with the character and appearance of the host building and the surrounding area of which it forms part, contrary to Policies DP3 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD6, DMD8, DMD14 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed development, in the absence of an adequate arboriculture report, has failed to demonstrate that the proposal would retain and protect trees of visual amenity and biodiversity value within the site contrary to Policies N2 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2021), Policies G7 of the London Plan (2021) and DMD 80 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014) and the British Standard for Trees in relation to design, demolition and construction (BS 5837:2012).

The proposed single storey side extension, in the absence of an adequate flood risk assessment fails to demonstrate how proposed measures manage the risk of flooding, contrary to Policies F7 and F8 National Planning Policy Framework (2026), SI 12 and SI 13 of the London Plan (2021), CP28 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD59, DMD60, DMD61 and DMD62 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014) and Enfield Strategic Flood Risk Assessment (2021).
